thesisQuality.note: Strong primary evidence of advanced-materials and contamination-control demand, improving adoption/economics and technical participation at next-generation nodes; exclusivity is not proven.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q2 sales grew 11.5% year over year, GAAP gross/operating margins expanded materially, six-month operating cash flow rose and debt declined, offset by still-material leverage and cyclicality.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: September 21 market data shows roughly $21.7B market cap and a high trailing/forward earnings multiple; growth is improving but valuation remains demanding relative to cyclical risk.

catalystScore.note: Q3 sales guidance of $905M-$935M plus ongoing advanced-node/3D process investment provide identifiable near-term operating and technology catalysts, though industry capex timing remains cyclical.

governancePower.note: 2026 proxy documents majority-independent board, independent committees, lead independent director, ownership requirements and anti-hedging/pledging rules; evidence supports strong governance without proving exceptional long-duration capital allocation.

alignment2036.note: Advanced semiconductor yield, purity and materials control are durable infrastructure capabilities for compute/electronics across multiple plausible technology futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Materials Solutions and Advanced Purity Solutions are distinct demand engines reusing semiconductor process expertise across unit-driven and capex-driven activity, but semiconductor exposure remains dominant.

bottleneckControl.note: Qualification-sensitive contamination/materials positions and advanced-node technical activity imply meaningful switching friction and scarcity participation, but no evidence proves exclusive system control.

scenarioRobustness.note: Consumables/materials plus capex-linked products and broad geographic operations provide multiple demand paths, offset by semiconductor-cycle and geopolitical concentration.

substitutionResilience.note: Process qualification and yield-critical integration create replacement friction, while new-node transitions still allow competitors or redesigns to displace incumbent positions.

supplyChainResilience.note: Global manufacturing footprint provides diversification, but company disclosures identify sole/single/limited-source supplier and geopolitical/export-control risks; resilience is mixed rather than strong.

pricingPower.note: Material gross-margin expansion and yield-critical qualified products support meaningful value capture, but direct price-pass-through/scarcity-rent evidence is insufficient for an 80+ band.

risk.note: Moderate risk reflects semiconductor cyclicality, material leverage, demanding valuation, disclosed supplier/geopolitical dependencies and substitution at node transitions, balanced by improving cash generation and deleveraging.

confidence.note: High confidence from current issuer results, SEC governance/annual-report lineage, technical primary evidence and independent current market data; reduced for unquantified customer concentration, advanced-node share and qualification duration.

thesis: Entegris is a yield-critical semiconductor materials and contamination-control supplier positioned to benefit from rising process complexity and advanced-node investment; operating momentum and deleveraging are strong, but a demanding valuation and semiconductor-cycle exposure constrain present asymmetry.
keyRisk: A semiconductor capex reversal, competitive displacement at process transitions, supplier/geopolitical disruption or persistent leverage could compress earnings and valuation simultaneously.
nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 results against $905M-$935M sales guidance and continued evidence of advanced-node qualification/ramp activity.
